```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

```{r}
experiment_name <- "demo_v1"
  
processed_data_folder <- here("data/processed_data", experiment_name)
```

```{r}
d_game <- read_csv(here(processed_data_folder, "games.csv"))
d_round <- read_csv(here(processed_data_folder, "rounds.csv"))
d_chat <- read_csv(here(processed_data_folder, "chats.csv"))
d_players <- read_csv(here(processed_data_folder, "players.csv"))

d_round <- d_round |> left_join(d_game)
```

```{r}
d_round_clean <-  d_round |> 
  group_by(gameID) |> 
  mutate(n_complete_rounds = sum(!is.na(response))) |> 
  filter(n_complete_rounds > 16) # only keep rounds that have enough responses
```

```{r}
d_round_clean |> ggplot(aes(x = trialNum, y = correct)) + 
  
```
